title: Classical training of conditional instantaneous quantum polynomial-time Born machines
abstract: arXiv:2611.05483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instantaneous quantum polynomial-time (IQP) Born machines are attractive quantum generative models, as certain IQP circuit families are conjectured to be hard to sample, yet they can be trained classically. Previously proposed conditional IQP Born machines make the parameters of the diagonal layer condition dependent. We introduce conditional IQP Born machines, in which the condition is encoded in the input state and a single IQP unitary is shared across conditions. Efficient sampling and amplitude-ratio evaluation for the reference state entering the diagonal layer suffice to obtain unbiased classical estimates of a conditional maximum mean discrepancy objective and its gradients. We show that input conditioning can represent conditional families that no diagonally conditioned IQP model with the same number of qubits can reproduce. translated_title: 条件型瞬时量子多项式时间Born机的经典训练
translated_abstract: 瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）Born机是一类颇具吸引力的量子生成模型，因为某些IQP电路族被猜想难以经典采样模拟，但它们却可以被经典地训练。先前提出的条件IQP Born机使对角层的参数依赖于条件。我们提出了一种条件IQP Born机，其中条件被编码在输入态中，并且一个单一的IQP酉算子在各个条件之间共享。只需对进入对角层的参考态进行高效采样和振幅比求值，即可获得条件最大均值差异目标函数及其梯度的无偏经典估计。我们证明，输入态条件化能够表示某些条件分布族，而任何在相同量子比特数目下采用对角条件化的IQP模型都无法复现这些分布族。对于十六量子比特的居里-外斯自旋模型，单一的条件模型即可捕获磁化转变……
tldr: 该论文提出将条件编码于输入态、跨条件共享单一IQP酉算子的条件IQP Born机，实现可经典无偏估计条件MMD目标与梯度的量子生成模型，且其表达能力超越了同等量子比特数下对角条件化的IQP模型。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces conditional IQP Born machines that encode conditions in the input state and share a single IQP unitary across conditions, enabling unbiased classical estimation of the conditional MMD objective and gradients, with expressive power beyond diagonally-conditioned IQP models of the same qubit number.
